hooks.text: 剑能招架、斧能横扫、灯收起后仍发光，每件物品都有两套动作和隐藏秘密
hooks.excerpt: Unique movesets: Swords parry, axes cleave, lanterns still shine when stowed - every item has two moves (and often hidden secrets!)
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 附魔与诅咒会彻底改写装备属性，武器护甲直接解锁能力而非百分比加成
hooks.excerpt: Enchantments and Curses: Find items imbued with dark magic that radically changes their properties! Infused spells, elemental affinities, mutations, and more - expect the unexpected. Abilities, not stats: No "+2% fire resist" here - rather than small stat increments, weapons and armor unlock new abilities and powers to face your enemies with.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 强力物品稀缺且只能携带有限数量，死亡后敌人陷阱重排但选择继续塑造下潜
hooks.excerpt: Meaningful choices: Not only are items powerful, they are scarce and you can only take what you can carry. Foes, traps, and hazards shift each time you die - but your choices will shape each Descent as well.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
